Given the ego vehicle's initial speed of 30 kph (~8.33 m/s) and the cyclist's position at x=23.0m, the cyclist will enter the drivable lane (y > -1.75m) in approximately 0.8 seconds, while the ego vehicle will reach the conflict point in approximately 2.76 seconds. This creates a high-risk conflict where the cyclist will be directly in the ego vehicle's path. Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate (A2) to yield to the crossing cyclist and avoid a collision.
